At Adriana's Permanent Makeup in Wilmington, MA, brows go through a natural process of light scabbing, lightening, and settling before the true color appears. Keeping the area clean and dry protects your investment, and cooler fall weather makes that far easier than midsummer. Curious what to expect while your brows heal? Book your microblading consultation at adrianaspmu.com and get every detail up front.

Every great permanent makeup result starts with a consultation, where your features, goals, and skin type guide the plan.

At Adriana's Permanent Makeup in Wilmington, MA, master artist Adriana Santos maps your brow shape, studies your natural tone, and talks through your routine before recommending a technique. Planning ahead for the holidays? Brows need about four weeks to heal, so October is the right time. Book your consultation at adrianaspmu.com.

Ready for soft, naturally tinted lips? Lip blush at Adriana's Permanent Makeup in Wilmington, MA gives you fresh color with no daily upkeep.

Lip blush enhances your natural lip tone and shape with gentle pigment, so your lips look polished from morning to night and photograph beautifully at every holiday gathering. Would you love to skip lipstick and still look put together? Book your lip blush appointment at adrianaspmu.com today.

Microblading uses delicate manual strokes to create natural, hair like brows that frame your face without looking drawn on.

At Adriana's Permanent Makeup in Wilmington, MA, microblading is one of the most requested brow services for clients across the Greater Boston area. Each stroke is mapped to your natural brow shape, growth pattern, and skin tone, so results look soft from across the room and realistic up close. Microblading typically lasts 1 to 3 years, and a follow up session 4 to 8 weeks later perfects color and shape.

Fall is one of the easiest seasons to heal brows, with no sun or pool to work around. Book your microblading consultation at adrianaspmu.com.

A permanent cat eye gives you a lifted, defined winged liner that stays sharp all day, with no unsteady hand required.

At Adriana's Permanent Makeup in Wilmington, MA, the top eyeliner cat eye extends your lash line into a clean, flattering wing shaped to your eye. It is ideal if you love a polished, editorial look but never quite get both sides even with liquid liner. The pigment lasts through long days, workouts, and every holiday party on your calendar, and it is refined during your included follow up.

Ever wish your winged liner looked this even every single morning? Book your cat eye eyeliner appointment at adrianaspmu.com.

Adriana's Permanent Makeup serves clients from Wilmington and across the Greater Boston and North Shore area, all from one trusted studio.

With over 20 years of experience and more than 5,000 procedures performed, master artist Adriana Santos delivers the same careful, personalized work to every client, whether they drive in from Boston, the North Shore, or a neighboring town.

Looking for a skilled permanent makeup artist near Greater Boston this fall? Book your appointment at adrianaspmu.com and see why clients travel to this studio.

Nano brows are an excellent choice for oily skin, because their ultra fine machine strokes hold up better than manual techniques.

At Adriana's Permanent Makeup in Wilmington, MA, nano brows deposit crisp, hair like strokes using a digital device, creating brows that look natural across all skin types. On oily skin, where microblading can soften and fade sooner, nano brows keep their definition longer. Each set is customized to your face, and results last 1 to 3 years with an included touch up at 4 to 8 weeks.

Has oily skin made you nervous about brow tattooing? Book a nano brows consultation at adrianaspmu.com and ask about your skin type.

Dark lip neutralization is a permanent makeup technique that balances naturally dark or uneven lip tones for a smoother, fresher base.

At Adriana's Permanent Makeup in Wilmington, MA, this treatment gently corrects hyperpigmentation before or alongside lip blush, so color looks even and true. It is a thoughtful option for clients whose lips carry cooler or darker pigment and who want a soft, natural result. Like other lip work, it is customized to your tone and refined during an included follow up session.

Have darker lip tones kept you from trying lip color? Book your lip consultation at adrianaspmu.com and see what neutralization can do.

You can refresh your brows and lips in a single visit with the eyebrows and lips combo at Adriana's Permanent Makeup in Wilmington, MA.

Combining brow work and lip blush in one session saves time and gives you a fully polished result that heals together. It is one of the most popular choices for clients who want a complete refresh before family photos and end of year events, and each service is still fully customized to your features. Let the studio know in advance so enough time is reserved for you.

Would you rather transform your whole look in one appointment? Book the brows and lips combo at adrianaspmu.com.

Microshading combines fine strokes with soft shading to create brows that are structured and defined yet still natural.

At Adriana's Permanent Makeup in Wilmington, MA, microshading is a great middle ground between crisp hair strokes and a full powdered look. It suits clients who want more definition than microblading alone but a softer finish than solid shading, and it wears well on combination and oily skin. Results last 1 to 3 years with an included touch up at 4 to 8 weeks.

Want brows with both structure and softness heading into the holidays? Book your microshading session at adrianaspmu.com.

Permanent eyeliner adds soft, lasting definition along your lash line, so your eyes look bright and awake the moment you get up.

At Adriana's Permanent Makeup in Wilmington, MA, classic top eyeliner is applied as a clean, natural line that suits every eye shape. Unlike pencil or gel liner, it will not smudge, run, or fade by midday, which makes it perfect for dark early mornings, the gym, and days that start before the sun does. The pigment is placed with precision and refined during your included follow up session.

Tired of reapplying eyeliner that never lasts the whole day? Book your permanent eyeliner appointment at adrianaspmu.com.

With over 20 years of experience and more than 5,000 procedures performed, Adriana's Permanent Makeup has become a trusted name across the North Shore and Massachusetts.

Experience matters in permanent makeup, because your face deserves a steady, practiced hand. Master artist Adriana Santos has spent two decades refining brow, lip, and eyeliner techniques, and every client works with a licensed, experienced artist who studies your features before a single stroke begins. That track record is why clients return and refer their friends.

The calendar fills quickly as the holiday season approaches. Book your appointment at adrianaspmu.com and put two decades of skill to work for you.

Powder brows create a soft, shaded finish that looks like a lightly filled in brow, defined yet still natural.

At Adriana's Permanent Makeup in Wilmington, MA, powder brows (also called ombre shading) are applied with a machine that builds a gentle gradient, lighter at the front and deeper toward the tail. They suit most skin types, including oily skin where hair stroke techniques can fade faster, and they are a favorite for anyone who fills in their brows daily. Results typically last 1 to 3 years with a touch up at 4 to 8 weeks.

Would you like to retire your brow pencil before the holidays? Book your powder brows session at adrianaspmu.com.

Existing permanent makeup from another artist can often be refreshed or corrected, once it is evaluated by a skilled artist.

At Adriana's Permanent Makeup in Wilmington, MA, older or uneven work is reviewed carefully, since previous pigment affects what is possible. Clients are asked to share a clear photo in natural light before booking so the right approach can be planned. From there, master artist Adriana Santos recommends a touch up or a correction that works with what is already there.

A new season is a good moment to reset brows that faded over the summer. Book an evaluation at adrianaspmu.com.
